    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActiveGameState
    Base for all non-terminal game states.
    BaseSearchNode<T>
    Abstract node in a game-tree search.
    BaseSearchTree<N>
    Base class for MCTS-style search trees.
    Bot
    Base class for bot players.
    Card
    Immutable value type representing a single playing card.
    CardDealer
    Static utility for dealing cards.
    Contract
    Configuration for a Barbu contract.
    ContractInProgress
    Game state while players are playing cards in an active contract.
    ContractState
    The in-progress state of a Barbu contract.
    Deck
    An ordered, duplicate-free collection of cards that can be shuffled and dealt.
    Deck.Variant
    Defines the available deck configurations.
    Determinizer
    Guesses a complete deal for the hidden cards, starting from the partial view a single player actually has.
    GameOver
    Game state after all declarers have completed all their contracts.
    GameSettings
    Configuration for a full game session.
    GameSettings.RankingOrder
     
    GameState
    The complete, immutable state of a Barbu game at a point in time.
    Hand
    Represents a player's hand of cards.
    HeuristicBot
    A contract-aware heuristic bot.
    History
    The completed-contract history of a Barbu game.
    History.FinishedContract
    An immutable summary of a completed contract: which contract was played and what scores resulted.
    IllegalMoveException
    Thrown when a Move is applied to a ContractState in which it is not legal.
    IsmctsBot
    Bot that uses Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search (ISMCTS) to select a Barbu move.
    IsmctsNode
    Search tree node for Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search
    IsmctsTree
    Search tree for Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search.
    LeadRestriction
    Defines which cards the leading player may play at the start of a trick.
    LeadRestriction.BrokenSuit
    A suit may not be led until it has been played off-suit in a previous trick.
    LeadRestriction.Composite
    Combines multiple restrictions.
    LeadRestriction.None
    No restriction
    LeadRestriction.OpeningPhase
    A suit may not be led during the first length tricks.
    MctsBot
    Monte Carlo Tree Search bot using determinized parallel tree voting.
    MctsNode
    MCTS tree node.
    MctsTree
    Thin orchestrator that runs one complete MCTS iteration on a determinized game state.
    MixedPolicyBot
    Bot that mixes two policies : on each decision it delegates to primary with probability primaryWeight, otherwise to fallback.
    Move
    A move a player can make during a game.
    Move.Pass
    Passes
    Move.PlayCard
    Plays a card from the player's hand.
    Move.SelectContract
    Declares a contract for the current round.
    PlayArea
    The visible state of the table during a contract.
    Player
    Represents the four players in the game, ordered clockwise.
    RandomMoveBot
    Bot that selects a legal move at random.
    Rank
    Represents the rank of a playing card, ordered from Rank.TWO (value 2) to Rank.ACE (value 14).
    ReussiteContract
    Contract configuration for the Réussite (solitaire-style) contract.
    ReussiteState
    In-progress state for a Réussite contract.
    ScoringPolicy
    A distinct scoring element within a trick-taking contract.
    ScoringPolicy.CardScoresPoints
    A specific card is worth points.
    ScoringPolicy.CompositeScoringPolicy
    Combines multiple scoring policies, summing their contributions per trick.
    ScoringPolicy.LastTwoTricksScorePoints
    Awards points to the winner(s) of the final 2 tricks of the round.
    ScoringPolicy.RankScoresPoints
    Cards of a specific rank are worth pointsPerCard each.
    ScoringPolicy.SuitScoresPoints
    Cards of a specific suit are worth pointsPerCard each.
    ScoringPolicy.TricksScorePoints
    Each trick taken is worth pointsPerTrick.
    Suit
    Represents one of the four card suits: Suit.CLUBS, Suit.DIAMONDS, Suit.HEARTS, Suit.SPADES.
    Tableau
    A shared card layout consisting of four suit piles, one per suit.
    Tableau.SuitPile
    Tracks the current extent of one suit's pile on the tableau.
    Trick
    An immutable record of one trick: the cards played so far and the order they were played.
    TrickTakingContract
    Contract configuration for a trick-taking contract.
    TrickTakingState
    In-progress state for a trick-taking contract.
    WaitingForContractSelection
    Game state while the current declarer is choosing which contract to play.
